criteria: reference-site evidence potentially verifiable from public sources

reviews.company_name: SERVICIOS INDUSTRIALES DE LA MARINA S.A.
reviews.reason: Official SIMA source identifies the exact reference address as its principal operating center and explicitly describes shipyard and metal-mechanics operations.
Official port-system documentation identifies a private specialized gas terminal administered by Zeta Gas Andino at the same Oquendo / Av. Nestor Gambetta location.
Current official regulatory sources place Antapaccay facilities and the Antapaccay–Tintaya mining operation at Campamento Minero Tintaya / Espinar, matching the reference-site identity.
Current official company contact material confirms the same Luis Galvani 356 address as an active Peru site. Pilot classification is office only; manufacturing at this address is not asserted.

Explomin's current official site lists Panamericana Sur Km. 22, Huertos de Conchán as Sede Central, while the Nexo reference site is based on the fiscal address Lote 2 Mza B, A.V. Villa El Milagro. CONTRACT 022 does not silently equate or replace those Sites.

Current public secondary sources confirm the fiscal address and active company status, but the pilot did not recover sufficiently strong primary evidence proving the reference address is an operating Site with a concrete Site function.
